structural_breaks.note: Siemens Ltd reorganised reportable segments in Q3 FY2019 (quarter ended 2019-06-30): 'Power and Gas' + transmission part of 'Energy Management' -> 'Gas and Power'; distribution -> Smart Infrastructure. Comparatives restated only from Apr-Jun 2018; earlier 'Power and Gas'/'Energy Management' history is a different scope and not included.

Q1 FY2020: new 'Portfolio Companies' segment; Gas and Power history restated again (e.g. Apr-Jun 2019 11,314 -> 11,590; FY2019 50,559 -> 51,736 INR mn). Handled via each point's own prior_year_comparative.
'Gas and Power' renamed 'Energy' (Q4 FY2020); no scope change indicated (15,830 identical in later statements).
From Q1 FY2025 Siemens Ltd presents Energy as discontinued operations; FY2024 quarters re-presented (Q1 11,454->11,173; Q3 14,865->14,509; Q4 20,758->20,163; FY 63,452->61,853).

Demerger of Siemens Ltd Energy business into Siemens Energy India Ltd: appointed date 2025-03-01, NCLT sanction & effective 2025-03-25, record date 2025-04-07, shares allotted 2025-04-14. Siemens Ltd Energy figures for Jan-Mar 2025 cover only up to 2025-03-01 -> FY2025Q2 predecessor point excluded; predecessor series ends FY2025Q1.
ENRIN listed on BSE/NSE. ENRIN (incorporated 2024-02-07) presents comparatives from incorporation on common-control basis (unaudited/unreviewed for periods to 30 Sep 2024).

profile.products: Power Transmission: power transformers up to 765 kV / 500 MVA, shunt reactors up to 765 kV, traction transformers up to 33 kV/10 MVA, AIS up to 800 kV, GIS up to 420 kV, bushings, instrument transformers & coils, HVDC thyristor valves/IGBT converters, FACTS (STATCOM, synchronous condensers), EHV substation EPC. Power Generation: gas & industrial steam turbines, generators, services. Recent export transformer orders: 4x150 MVA 345 kV to the largest semiconductor facility in the USA; 240 MVA transformer to a US energy company; 5x300 MVA to a US renewable company (IM p.12, p.85, p.120; presentations Dec-2025, H1/9M FY26).

plants.products: power transformers & reactors; traction transformers (capacity expansion under INR 7,400 mn capex)

plants.city: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad, Waluj MIDC, Maharashtra) — 3 factories

plants.products: HVDC thyristor valves, racks, IGBT converters, transportation units; repair centre
digital control systems and test bed

profile.end_markets: Indian transmission utilities (765 kV bulk transformers, ISTS), HVDC & FACTS, renewables integration, industry (steel, process), power generation (gas/steam turbines); exports mainly via Siemens Energy group sales channels (US large transformers, GIS exports, African metro).

gaps: ENRIN own series starts FY2024Q3 (Apr-Jun 2024); FY2024Q3-FY2025Q1 exist only as common-control comparatives (comparative_only). Only 9 quarters -> primary_target stays revenue_total per rule (<16 quarters); use revenue_predecessor_segment for longer history.
ENRIN FY2025Q2 (Jan-Mar 2025): no prior_year_comparative (the printed comparative covers 7 Feb-31 Mar 2024 only).

Predecessor (Siemens Ltd Energy): FY2025Q2 excluded (covers 1 Jan-1 Mar 2025 only); nothing before FY2018Q3 because the Energy/Gas and Power segment did not exist before the Q3 FY2019 reorganisation (old Power and Gas / Energy Management segments are a different scope).
Orders: ENRIN discloses new orders only half-yearly/annually in presentations (e.g. H1 FY26 66.6 bn, PT 43.4 bn); no quarterly orders_segment built.

Scope: consolidated segment statements; Energy segment revenue is identical in standalone and consolidated statements in every quarter where both were checked (FY2019Q3, FY2020Q2-Q3, FY2021Q1-Q4, FY2022Q2-Q4, FY2023Q3-Q4, FY2024Q1-Q2, FY2025Q1), so the two standalone-sourced points (FY2020Q4, FY2022Q1) are same-scope.
